metadata.title: FVS-ACD (Acadian variant of the Forest Vegetation Simulator), v12.10.1

creators.name: Weiskittel, Aaron
creators.affiliation: Center for Research on Sustainable Forests, University of Maine

metadata.description: FVS-ACD is an independent Acadian growth and yield model for the mixed spruce, fir, and northern hardwood forests of the Acadian region, implemented in R as an Acadian variant of the Forest Vegetation Simulator and benchmarked on the FIA National Scale Volume and Biomass (NSVB) system. Version 12.10.1 is the frozen August 2026 operational release: the v12.9.x base (coupled two-segment relative-density mortality with density-released ingrowth, composition- and ecoregion-aware brms maximum stand density index, and an ESI-consistent dominant-height anchor recalibration) plus gated Chapter 11 direct-effect management modifiers, off by default. The deposit contains the frozen R model source, the full independent benchmark report, the variant overview GTR draft, six summary figures, and the aggregate five-way scorecard. On the pooled cell OSM slightly leads on level bias and modeling efficiency; FVS-ACD leads on Bakuzis biological realism, long-horizon self-thinning, quadratic mean diameter, and transparency, with a disclosed ingrowth under-prediction. The lead visual (00_FVS-ACD_v12101_graphical_abstract.png) is the graphical abstract. No FIA true plot coordinates and no proprietary provincial per-stand data are included; aggregates only.
